description: Create the submission form authors fill in — the questions a call for papers asks, such as a title, an abstract, a track and a file upload. Use it after create_draft_conference, because a conference with no submission form has nothing for anyone to submit to. Pass the questions as a simple list; each needs a label and a type (text, paragraph, rich_text, choice, multi_choice, checkbox, file, date, number, email), and choice and multi_choice also need options. IMPORTANT — the form is created as a DRAFT and accepts nothing until a human publishes it in the dashboard, so tell the user that submissions are not open yet and that they must publish it and then set the submission window. This creates a simple question list; pages, sections, conditional logic and layout are done in the dashboard's form builder afterwards. Requires an OAuth connection and the admin role on the event. If the response includes a `links` object or a `dashboardUrl`, give the user the actual URL as a clickable link rather than describing where to click — they are in a chat, not in the product, and cannot navigate from a description.

eventId.description: Event UUID from list_my_events — not the URL slug.

name.description: What the form is called, e.g. "Call for Papers".

questions.description: The questions, in the order authors will see them.

description.description: Help text shown under the question.

label.description: The question as the author will read it.

options.description: The choices, for a choice or multi_choice question. Required for those two types.

required.description: Whether an author must answer it. Defaults to false.

type.description: What kind of answer this question takes.

name: create_call_for_papers
title: Create a call-for-papers form
